1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is distinct from BVDV-1a and BVDV-2__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, provided that the viral-specific antigens are different from those present in the BVDV-1b.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein said modified, live viruses are different from the BVDV-lb virus.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen __that is distinct from the BVDV antigens__.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated and __different from the antigens in the modified live viruses used in the composition of claim 1__.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __a first microbial pathogen-specific antigen that is not included in prior art compositions including BVDV-1b__.
